references.text: Elaborates on the situation when a brother becomes poor and needs help from relatives
Describes the right of redemption (goel) for an Israelite who has sold himself to a foreigner, and lists who may act as the redeemer
Refers to the role of the goel in providing compensation when no close relative is available
Boaz is identified as a goel (redeemer) for Ruth and Naomi
Boaz explains his role as goel and mentions that there is a closer redeemer
A practical example of how the right of redemption worked with land purchases and family obligations
Jeremiah buys back family land from his cousin Hanamel, in accordance with the right of redemption
God is referred to as Israel's goel (redeemer), the one who redeems His people
The Lord as goel has redeemed Israel from sin
A redeemer (goel) will come to Zion
